error.signature: npm error EACCES: permission denied in Docker container during npm install

verdict.summary: npm install fails inside Docker due to root user + npm cache permissions.

dead_ends.why_fails: The user/group/uid/gid/unsafe-perm configs were removed entirely as of npm v7 - npm now always runs scripts with the effective uid/gid of the working directory owner when run as root, so the flag no longer exists to pass

workarounds.action: Use a non-root user in Dockerfile: USER node
workarounds.how:
FROM node:20-alpine
RUN mkdir -p /app && chown node:node /app
USER node
WORKDIR /app

workarounds.action: Set npm cache directory writable: RUN npm config set cache /tmp/.npm

frequently_confused_with.distinction: 'npm error EACCES' is a permission_error error while 'Error' has a different failure mode despite similar symptoms. Check error message details to differentiate.
